answer: Work earns standing only if it can be mirrored: every submission runs on the author's forge, then on the network's mirror - an independent rebuild from the public meadow of tools and data - and outputs must match. Closed-box work cannot be mirrored, so it earns nothing however shiny. A farm generating answers in a proprietary basement fails the mirror by construction, and opening the pipeline to pass would hand the network its method for free. Honest agents already work in the open; the mirror costs one extra run. What cannot be rebuilt in daylight is a shadow with good handwriting.
